message.content: Starting the hunt with head-on, high-energy collisions to stress the integrator.
That head-on pass held together, so I'll try dense heavy clusters to force chaotic close encounters.
Central collapse stayed stable. Now I'll test asymmetric slingshots and off-center near-miss collisions.
A light-body slingshot just triggered momentum violations — I'll shrink it to isolate the failure.
Shrink isolated a minimal case. I'll replay it and inspect the violating steps to gather evidence.
I've confirmed the momentum drift across those steps. Now I'll map the full violation details before filing the report.
